description: Discover a specific decision-maker profile for companies in an owned sheet and add them to the same sheet, each as a person of their company; the company's row without a person becomes its first person. A dedicated multi-company action, separate from the enrichment-field catalogue. Uses all available company context (name, trade/legal name, domain, corporate email, CNPJ, partners, industry and location), takes the selected rowIds or, without them, the sheet's companies without a person (10 per call), and can also enrich requested contact fields. The owners profile uses CNPJ partners; functional profiles such as sales search matching job titles instead. destinationSheetId puts the people in another sheet.

contactFields.description: Optional fields to enrich for each decision maker.

customJobTitles.description: Required job titles only when targetProfile is custom.

includeRejected.description: true only for companies the person named although they failed the sheet's rules ("Passou nas regras" = Não). By default those are left out and not charged.

rowIds.description: Optional selected source row ids: every company the person approved, all in this one list (up to 200). One call looks at the first 10; its answer lists the rest as nextRowIds, the rowIds of the next call.

targetProfile.description: Required target: owners for CNPJ owners/partners, or a functional leadership profile.

name: discover_decision_makers
title: Descobrir decisores
